The painted edges are ragged and darken to black where the paint meets the gold of the rod; the background is transparent.

brown-bull-with-upturned-head.description: The Taurus sign from the zodiac initial. A reddish-brown bull walks to the left in side view with its head raised and mouth open, two dark curved horns, a lighter muzzle and belly, dark hooves and a tail that curls up behind the hindquarters. Darker brown shading with white highlights and black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

brown-bull-with-upturned-head.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline.
brown-bull-with-upturned-head.title: Taurus, brown bull
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

dark-green-scorpion-with-raised-tail.description: The Scorpio sign from the zodiac initial, drawn as a dark green lizard-like creature rather than a bird. A plump body lies diagonally with a long tapering tail pointing to the upper left, two tufts of spiky legs on the underside and a small curled head with bristling appendages at the lower right. Dark green with gold-brown streaks and black shading; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

dark-green-scorpion-with-raised-tail.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline.

The pointed end at the upper left is the tail, not a beak; the head is the small curled end at the lower right.

embracing-zodiac-twins.description: The Gemini sign from the zodiac initial. Two fair-haired figures with curly gold hair sit side by side and embrace, the left one in a blue gown with a red belt looking up at the other, the right one in a brown-mauve gown with its arm round the first; their blue-clad legs stretch out together to the right. Cream faces and hands, black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

embracing-zodiac-twins.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline.

fruit-tree-with-branching-trunk.description: A tall tree with a straight olive-brown trunk edged in gold that spreads into a flat base of short roots and branches into three rounded clumps of dark green foliage, one above the other two. Twelve round rust-red fruits hang among the leaves, each with a dark stalk, and the leaves carry pale grey highlights and flecks of gold where the paint has worn. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Tree of life with its twelve fruits

fruit-tree-with-branching-trunk.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the foliage keeps the original abrasion, with gold ground and pale losses flecking the leaves.
fruit-tree-with-branching-trunk.title: Tree of life with red fruits
usage_notes: The main miniature of the folio; the two margin rods of the same folio (upper-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r, lower-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r) frame it on the page.

gold-lion-with-curled-tail.description: The Leo sign from the zodiac initial. A tawny gold lion walks to the left with its head turned towards the viewer, mouth open and red-tipped, its mane and flanks drawn in wavy darker strokes with white highlights; the long tail curls up over the back and ends in a leafy tuft above the hindquarters. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

gold-scales-with-two-blue-pans.description: The Libra sign from the zodiac initial. A blue beam edged with white rests on a gold and blue two-legged post topped by a small bird-like finial with a pale head and a red-spotted body; from each end of the beam three gold cords hang a round blue pan with white highlights. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

gold-scales-with-two-blue-pans.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline, and the cords are thin and ragged.

usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

gothic-tiered-fountain-with-water-jets.description: The stone fountain from the Fountain of Life miniature, seen from slightly above. A grey-green octagonal basin on a stepped base carries an upper hexagonal basin and a central Gothic pavilion with pointed arches, crockets and a tall crocketed spire ending in a cross; two spouts in the upper basin and six spouts round the lower basin pour wavy white and blue jets of water down the sides. Gold highlights along the right edges, dark green shading; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Fountain of life and the four rivers of paradise

gothic-tiered-fountain-with-water-jets.title: Gothic fountain of life
usage_notes: Centrepiece of the miniature, flanked by left-dark-leafy-tree and right-dark-leafy-tree; the water jets end at the basin foot, so set it on a ground or a dark panel.

gray-curled-horn-ram.description: The Aries sign from the zodiac initial. A grey-cream ram stands facing left in side view with its head lowered, two dark spiralling horns, a fleece drawn in curling brown strokes over a pale body and small dark hooves. Gold flecks over the fleece, white highlights and black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

gray-long-horned-goat.description: The Capricorn sign from the zodiac initial, drawn as an ordinary goat. A grey goat stands facing right in side view with two long dark horns sweeping back from its head, a small beard, a shaggy coat drawn in wavy white and dark grey strokes and dark cloven hooves. Gold flecks over the coat and black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

gray-long-horned-goat.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline.

left-dark-leafy-tree.description: A tall slender tree from the Fountain of Life miniature. A dark olive-brown trunk with gold flecks curves up from a cut base at the lower left to a small crown of dark green lobed leaves at the top, with pale grey-white fruits hanging among the upper leaves and a few leaves scattered down the right side of the stem. Painted edges, no outline; the background is transparent.

A short vertical gold rod edged in pink ends above in a pink curl with gold trefoil leaves and a red flower, and below in a gold leaf cluster from which a long pink stem runs to the right along the bottom, throwing off gold trefoil ivy leaves, a blue and a pale green-white bell flower, two red flowers and fine black hairline curls. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

A long silver-grey fish swims to the left in side view with its mouth slightly open, a darker blue-grey back, white highlights along the belly and gold flecks; the dorsal, pectoral and pelvic fins and the forked tail are edged in red. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

oval-celestial-scene-with-stars-and-cres.description: A tall oval of deep blue sky with a rim of lighter blue brushstrokes following its edge. Three gold six-pointed stars sit in the upper left and upper right, a gold disc crossed by dark curved bands lies right of centre, and a dark worn crescent with its horns down sits at the bottom left. A fourth star and much of the lower half are abraded to a pale green-grey ground. Opaque inside the oval, transparent outside.

red-crab-with-raised-claws.description: The Cancer sign from the zodiac initial, drawn like a crayfish. A red-orange crustacean lies diagonally with its head and two black-dot eyes at the upper left, two large claws raised above it, four thin legs spread to the right and below, and a segmented tail curving down to the lower right. Dark red shading, gold flecks and black outlines; the background is transparent.

right-dark-leafy-tree.description: A round-headed tree from the Fountain of Life miniature. A dense dark green crown with a scalloped outline fills the upper two thirds, with brown branches, pale grey-white fruits and a few lighter leaves showing through it; two thin grey-brown trunks run down from the crown and cross near the cut base at the bottom. Painted edges, no outline; the background is transparent.

seated-archer-with-hoofed-legs.description: The Sagittarius sign from the zodiac initial. A satyr-like archer with a bare pale human torso, curly gold hair and brown furred goat legs with black cloven hooves sits on his haunches facing left and draws a tall gold bow with both hands; a thin tail curls out behind him at the left. Pink shading on the skin, white highlights on the fur and black outlines; the background is transparent.

seated-maiden-holding-small-flowers.description: The Virgo sign from the zodiac initial. A young woman with gold hair sits on the ground in a long brown gown whose folds spread to the lower right, her body turned to the right and her head tilted back towards the viewer; her raised right hand holds a thin stem with a gold flower and a second gold-flowered sprig rises from her lap. Pale face and hands with pink shading, white highlights on the gown and black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

upper-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r.title: Margin rod with foliate branch, upper, fol. 74r
usage_notes: Sits at the top-left of a page; lower-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r is its bottom-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the tree of life.

upper-left-curled-ivy-with-trefoils.description: A thick grey-pink stem edged in white curls into a spiral at the lower centre and sends branches up and to the left, each ending in a gold trefoil ivy leaf with a white centre; a blue three-lobed flower with white highlights sits inside the spiral and a cluster of gold leaves closes its tail at the lower left. Fine grey hairline tendrils trail from the leaves. The paint is worn, with parchment showing through the gold. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Seven planets (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, sun, Venus, Mercury, and moon)

upper-left-curled-ivy-with-trefoils.quality: The gold leaves are abraded with parchment showing through, and the stem at the upper right ends in a cut.
upper-left-curled-ivy-with-trefoils.title: Curled ivy stem with gold trefoils
usage_notes: From the upper-left margin of the folio whose rod is lower-left-rod-with-ivy-flourish-10r; the cut stem at the upper right is where it joined the rod.

upper-left-pink-ivy-flourish.description: A top-left corner piece of the page border without a rod. A pink stem edged in white rises from a spiral at the lower left, where a gold trefoil leaf and a blue flower sit inside the curl, bends over and runs to the right along the top carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves with white centres, two blue and two red-orange bell flowers and fine black hairline tendrils; a second small spiral with a gold leaf closes the stem at the bottom. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

upper-left-pink-ivy-flourish.title: Ivy spray corner, upper left, fol. 12r
usage_notes: Sits at the top-left of a page with the spray along the top edge; lower-left-rod-with-ivy-flourish-12r is its bottom-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the zodiac initial.

upper-silver-fish-with-red-fins.description: The upper fish of the Pisces pair from the zodiac initial. A long fish swims to the left in side view, its back dark blue-grey and its belly silver-grey with white highlights and gold flecks; the dorsal fin, pectoral and pelvic fins and the forked tail are edged in red. Black outlines; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Twelve signs of the zodiac

upper-silver-fish-with-red-fins.quality: Flecks of the gold ground of the initial remain on the paint and along the outline.
upper-silver-fish-with-red-fins.title: Pisces, upper fish
usage_notes: Pisces is the pair; in the initial this fish swims above lower-silver-fish-with-red-fins, both heading left.
One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

worn-gold-curled-celestial-roundel.description: A roughly circular gold disc crossed by five dark curved bands that sweep from the upper left like the ribs of a shell, cut from the oval night sky of the folio. The gilding is worn, with the dark blue ground showing through across the lower half and the edge ragged. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Seven planets (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, sun, Venus, Mercury, and moon)

worn-gold-curled-celestial-roundel.quality: Worn gilding with the blue ground showing through; the edge of the disc is ragged where the paint ends.
worn-gold-curled-celestial-roundel.title: Gold disc with curved bands
usage_notes: Cut from oval-celestial-scene-with-stars-and-crescent; it carries traces of the blue ground, so it reads best on a dark background.
